steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease 12 muffin cups.
Stir together flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl until well combined; set aside.

Beat together sugar and butter with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth. Add 1 egg and blend until incorporated. Add milk, remaining egg, and vanilla and beat until well combined. Mix in flour mixture until just incorporated. Divide batter into the prepared muffin cups.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden and the tops spring back when lightly pressed, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Grandmother’s Muffins
raw_recipe.description: Try this old family recipe for basic muffins made with flour, butter, sugar, milk, eggs, and vanilla — just like Grandma used to make.
raw_recipe.name: Grandmother’s Muffins

review.reviewBody: excellent!! I was looking for a basic muffin recipe, that I could add to anything I had on hand (chocolate chips, dried fruit, nuts etc). This one is perfect! The only modification I made was 2 cups of flour instead of 1 3/4. Also, I made a batch following the instructions carefully, and another batch where I mixed the 2 eggs with the sugar, butter and vanilla all together, then added the milk, then the flour. Both batches came out exactly the same- so no need to follow all those steps.. :). Muffins came out nice and fluffy, with a crispy top- just excellent! Will sure keep as a favorite! Thanks for sharing!

Used 2 cups flour, 1/4 cup each butter and vegetable oil, 2jumbo eggs, 1/4 c jelled cranberry sauce, 1/4 tsp backing soda, 1 tsp cinnamon, added: 1 cup grated carrots and 1/2 cup raisins and crasins. Made 12 really beautiful muffins filled tin 3/4 full. 30 minutes on 350 was perfect,

These are really light and melt in your mouth! The batter is pretty runny, but if you really let the beater fluff up the mix, almost like meringue, they come out airy and just sweet enough. I used an ice cream scoop to fill the cups to have minimal deflate to the batter. I also added blueberries to half the muffins but the batter is so light they all sank to the bottoms of the cups, which is okay I guess, but next time I may do a quick chop on the blueberries to see if they will stay suspended in the batter a bit better. Great with coffee!

Great recipe like most people I went with 2 cups of flour and 1 teaspoon of nutmeg and as a last step add 1 cup of blueberries.
This is now a family favourite and have passed on recipe to friends.
Thank you for the recipe

I made it this morning and it is pretty good:) I followed the other reviewer's advice to increase the flour to 2 cups. I mixed all the wet ingredients then added the dry ingredients, and it still came out good. I divided up to two patches--added chocolate chips to one and white chocolate chips and dried cranberry to another. Both variations turned out good, but a little too sweet to my taste. I will cut down the sugar to 3/4cup(or more)the next time if adding chocolate chips/dried fruits. This one is a keeper:)
Great Base Recipe for Muffin. I increased the flour to 2 C, and put 2 C of Fresh Bluberries and bake for 25 mins. The taste and texture is amazing!! This is a keeper!!
I made as directed in there instructions and they were good. I added chocolate chips and cranberries to a second batch and they were delicious.

Easy to follow recipe that can be used as a basic muffin and still allow for tweaking to personal taste. I've taken and cut the flour to just 1 cup and added 1 cup of wheat bran, used 1/3 cup applesauce in place of butter, added 1 tbsp. cinnamon, and substituted brown sugar in place of white to make my basic muffin. The flavor and texture is incredible, I've added blueberries to some, Apples to some and pecans to others. I don't think you can go wrong with this recipe. Try adding your favorite fruit, nut or anything and try for yourself.

Really quite delicious. We followed the recipe to a T for all except the baking. We baked it at 150 degrees c for five mins less and they turned into a beautiful light gold brown top with a moist inside. Absolutely amazing with some strawberry jam or any fruit jelly. I was a little worried they might end up looking like the picture which looks rather burnt but with this adjustment they came out perfectly!

These muffins were quite good. I went with 2 cups of flour bc the mix seemed too runny. I also added a little bit of lemon zest, some chocolate chips, and some sliced almonds. Great for breakfast, which is what I intend to do with them. I used large muffin pans and made 8 instead of 12, cooking them for 35 min. Perfect!

The muffins turned out okay; next time I will increase the flour to 2 cups. I added chocolate chips and orange zest... will try other variations next time. The muffins were springy to touch but the tops didn’t brown. Mine were done in about 22 mins at 180 degrees (my microwave convection oven doesn’t allow for 175).

Great recipe! In my country it's difficult to find the right temperature because our ovens have gas mark (max, min, med) so I had to guess a little. Mine was a bit too hot so they were done 10 min before expected, a little browned under and the sides but yummy. Next time I'll try using 2 cups of flour as I found the batter a bit thin and they didn't 'pop' but stretched and rose. Delicious flavour. But I substituted butter by oil, so maybe that's why they weren't as described in the recipe. Great addition to our family's rotation of recipes.

Added the extra flour to 2 cups as some reviewers noted but next time, I’ll stick to 1 3/4 cups as they seemed heavy. I added cherries macerated with brown sugar to the top and they were so good! Easy recipe to adapt and add all kinds of fruits

Each time I attempted to make this recipe, my muffins would not rise and they had a bitter taste. I followed the instructions exactly as they were written and it didn't work. I will be looking for a new recipe.

I was looking for a muffin recipe for peach turnovers and I finally just gave in and clicked here. THIS IS A GREAT. RECIPE!!! I love how simple it is and it really made my peach turnovers become whole!!!
Surprisingly addictive. They kept calling my name like I was the muffin whisperer.
Perfect! So easy my 10 year old son did it all by himself while I coached. We sprinkled a few chocolate chips on top.
Great taste!
I upped the recipe to 2 cups flour and 2 tsp vanilla. I also added 1/2 tsp cinnamon and 1/2 cup chocolate chips. So yummy!
Tasty basic muffin to which you can add any fruit
